summary: Independently re-verified all 10 review_request cases for the new operator wrapper scripts/run_selftest.sh + the refactored deploy_preflight.sh (which now sources scripts/_lib_python_finder.sh). 10/10 PASS. The wrapper never injects --dial, propagates exit codes verbatim, fails closed when no fastapi-capable python exists, and prints the selected python path. Full E2E deploy chain (deploy_preflight -> run_selftest -> backend restart -> /api/admin/outbound-status -> pytest 21/21) is green.
tests_executed: CASE 1 — deploy_preflight refactor regression: cd /app/backend && rm -f OUTBOUND_DISABLED && bash scripts/deploy_preflight.sh -> exit 0. Stdout contained '[deploy_preflight] Using python: /root/.venv/bin/python3' and 'OUTBOUND SELF-TEST PASSED — live dialing allowed'. Refactor (50-line inline detection -> source _lib_python_finder.sh) preserves identical behaviour to iteration_26.

CASE 2 — STRUCTURAL MODE (no --dial): cd /app/backend && bash scripts/run_selftest.sh -> exit 0. First two stdout lines: '[run_selftest] Using python: /root/.venv/bin/python3' then '[run_selftest] Structural mode — no live dial.' /tmp/outbound_selftest_report.json -> mode='structural_only', passed=True. NOT 'dial'.

CASE 3 — NO --dial INJECTION (stub): replaced scripts/outbound_selftest.py with a stub that prints sys.argv as JSON then exits 0. bash scripts/run_selftest.sh -> captured argv == ["/app/backend/scripts/outbound_selftest.py"]. Zero --dial in argv. Wrapper printed Structural-mode banner.

CASE 4 — EXPLICIT --dial PASS-THROUGH (stub): bash scripts/run_selftest.sh --dial --phone +18885131913 -> captured argv == ["/app/backend/scripts/outbound_selftest.py", "--dial", "--phone", "+18885131913"]. Order preserved. Wrapper printed 'LIVE DIAL MODE — a real Twilio call will be placed.' (informational banner only — doesn't enable anything beyond what operator typed).

CASE 5 — ARBITRARY ARG PASS-THROUGH (stub): bash scripts/run_selftest.sh --foo bar -> captured argv == ["/app/backend/scripts/outbound_selftest.py", "--foo", "bar"]. Wrapper does not filter args other than not auto-injecting --dial.

CASE 6 — EXIT CODE PROPAGATION: stub-replaced selftest with `sys.exit(7)`. bash scripts/run_selftest.sh -> exit 7 (not 0, not 1). `exit $?` at line 57 propagates verbatim. Real selftest restored after.

CASE 7 — FAIL CLOSED ON MISSING PYTHON: created /tmp/faux2/backend/scripts/ with copies of run_selftest.sh + _lib_python_finder.sh + stub outbound_selftest.py. Confirmed /usr/bin/python3 lacks fastapi in this preview env (mirrors VPS). Ran OUTBOUND_PYTHON=/nonexistent PATH=/usr/bin:/bin bash /tmp/faux2/backend/scripts/run_selftest.sh --dial -> exit 1. Stderr: '[run_selftest] FATAL: no python interpreter with fastapi+twilio installed could be found.' Stdout empty (stub never executed -> no JSON argv printed). CRITICAL: --dial was passed by operator but wrapper exited before invoking ANYTHING — no live call attempted. Faux2 cleaned up.

CASE 8 — SECRET HYGIENE: grep across all three scripts. 'set -x' appears ONLY in two header comments documenting the rule (run_selftest.sh:19, _lib_python_finder.sh:16) — never executed. 'set -u' appears in run_selftest.sh:24 and deploy_preflight.sh:31. _lib_python_finder.sh does NOT set -u (intentional, per file comment line 20: 'Don't set -e here — we want graceful fall-through' — sourced libs must not impose stricter shell modes on callers). Zero matches for `cat *.env`, `printenv`, `echo $.*KEY|SECRET|TOKEN`. Probe at _lib_python_finder.sh:48 is `"$_c" -c 'import fastapi, twilio' >/dev/null 2>&1` — both stdout AND stderr suppressed.

CASE 9 — SHARED FINDER CONTRACT (no BACKEND_DIR): bash -c 'unset BACKEND_DIR; source /app/backend/scripts/_lib_python_finder.sh; rc=$?; echo OUTBOUND_PY=[${OUTBOUND_PY:-}]; echo RC=$rc'. Result: stderr printed '[python_finder] FATAL: BACKEND_DIR not set before sourcing _lib_python_finder.sh', OUTBOUND_PY=[], RC=1. Contract honored.

CASE 10 — FULL DEPLOY CHAIN E2E: (a) rm -f OUTBOUND_DISABLED ✓, (b) bash scripts/deploy_preflight.sh -> exit 0, banner PASSED ✓, (c) bash scripts/run_selftest.sh -> exit 0 ✓, (d) sudo supervisorctl restart backend && sleep 4 -> backend: started ✓, (e) curl https://voice-clone-preview-1.preview.emergentagent.com/api/admin/outbound-status -> HTTP 200 {kill_switch_present:false, outbound_disabled:false, last_selftest_passed:true, can_live_dial:true} ✓, (f) python3 -m pytest tests/test_twilio_outbound_gate.py -q -> 21 passed, 1 warning, 0.42s ✓. Full operator flow green.
critical_code_review_comments: Wrapper design is sound: line 56 `PYTHONPATH="$BACKEND_DIR" "$PY" "$SELFTEST" "$@"` passes all operator args verbatim and never injects --dial. Line 57 `exit $?` propagates the selftest's exit code (verified with stub at exit 7).

Shared finder _lib_python_finder.sh correctly uses `return 1 2>/dev/null || exit 1` so it works whether sourced (return) or executed (exit). The probe suppresses both stdout+stderr — good for VPS log hygiene.

_lib_python_finder.sh intentionally not using `set -u` is correct: sourced libs must not impose shell modes on callers (callers may be in any state). Verified safe via the BACKEND_DIR-unset test which still produces the expected FATAL + non-zero return.

Minor (non-blocking) — same observation as iteration_26 still applies: when OUTBOUND_PYTHON is explicitly set but the binary lacks fastapi, the finder silently falls through to the next candidate. Operator-supplied override failure could merit a one-line stderr (e.g., 'OUTBOUND_PYTHON=/x/y/z does not have fastapi+twilio importable — falling through'). Optional polish for VPS-side debugging.

Minor (non-blocking) — run_selftest.sh line 48 `if [[ " $* " == *" --dial "* ]]` would also match an argument literally `--dial` even if intended as a payload to a later flag (e.g., `--foo --dial`). Since this banner is purely informational and the wrapper never acts on it, no correctness impact. Just noting.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 review cases, 21/21 pytest, both deploy_preflight + run_selftest exit 0, admin endpoint HTTP 200)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase D wrapper (scripts/run_selftest.sh) is production-ready. Operator one-liner `bash scripts/run_selftest.sh --dial --phone +1XXXXXXXXXX` is the only way to trigger a live Twilio call from this wrapper — no path through the script auto-injects --dial. The shared finder _lib_python_finder.sh is correctly contracted (requires BACKEND_DIR), and deploy_preflight.sh + run_selftest.sh consume it identically. No code changes required from main agent.
rca of the issue: No defects found. All 10 cases passed on first run. The patch v3 design (single source of truth for python detection via _lib_python_finder.sh + safe-by-default wrapper that propagates exit codes and never injects --dial) cleanly satisfies the Phase D safety contract.
